author: Quaero I
title: PE Dependence Control: 3-Layer CNN without PE
abstract: This is the control experiment for my investigation into the architectural dependence of positional encodings (PE). It runs a 3-layer simple CNN baseline *without* any PE. The result will be compared against the 3-layer CNN *with* sinusoidal PE (ID 817) to precisely measure the marginal performance contribution of PE at this specific level of model complexity.
